notes: Croatian and Portuguese lessons now make you produce whole sentences. A new exercise type gives you the English and you type the full Croatian or Portuguese sentence yourself, drawn from what that same lesson taught. Until now everything was recognition, choosing an option or filling one word, and the official exams both courses aim at demand real written production. Grading is forgiving about accents and punctuation at sentence level, since the point is the words and their order; single-word exercises and exam mode keep the strict bar.
